profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at Acushnet Company
profile.summary:
I'm a software & database developer with 25+ years of experience and knowledge designing, developing and maintaining a wide variety of web and desktop applications and solutions. Full stack developer with strong back-end and front-end development experience. Expert in database implementation and administration as well as BI solutions and understanding. Result driven, ability to meet deadline with high quality standards, self-motivated and pragmatic problem solver. Always interested in learning new technologies as well. 

Skills: 
Language : C#, VB.NET, T-SQL, XAML, HTML/CSS, XML, VBScript, JavaScript, PHP, Classic ASP
Framework: .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET, UWP, Struts
Database: MSSQL2005+, MySQL, Oracle, MS Access 
Others:  AJAX, jQuery, JSON, REST API, TFS, Git, SSIS/DTS, SSRS/SSAS, Dynamics GP, IBM Cognos, SharePoint, PowerShell, AWS, IIS, RedGate, Scrum, Spiceworks, UML, Pivotal Tracker, Jira, Confluence

Certifications:
Microsoft Certified Solution Developer (2000)
Microsoft Certified DataBase Administrator (1999)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Lead and oversee all the technical back-office operations and implementations to ensure integrity and effectiveness. 
• Maintain database, perform administrative tasks including query tuning, database optimization, performance monitoring, SQL replication, mirroring, availability group, and intensive ETL/SSIS jobs with various type of external data sources along with automation and web scrapping.
• Design, develop and maintain several customized web/client applications and solutions to support various back-end e-commerce and warehouse operations. 
• Develop/design/manage/support product catalog (2.5M SKUs) and content management system (CMS) for merchandising. 
• Introduce/design/implement new mobile solution with UWP app/Surface devices to improve efficiency/performance on daily order fulfillment and inventory operations. 
• Responsible for maintaining and creating BI reporting (SSRS/SSAS/GP) and solutions to support data-driven business decisions to stakeholders. 
• Dynamics GP professional to develop and manage in-house project implementation and integration with back-office system for Accounting. 
• Back-end integration and support for various third-party e-commerce solutions and partners such as ActiveCampaign, ChannelAdvisor, PowerReview, Certona, Elasticsearch, Oracle Endeca and so forth. 
• Implemented several front-end web projects for site search, merchandising, checkout enhancement, customer reviews, price guarantee program, etc.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description: Performed relational database design and normalization intensively in complex biological schemas and relationship under SQL2000. Designed/developed web-based laboratory application to collaborate/manage/process experiment data and analytic information using ASP.NET/C#/SQL. Sucessfully delivered the desired results under tight deadlines.

company.name: La Jolla Institute for Allergy and Immunology

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built a web-based mobile application named Gallery Explorer including back-end content management system. Participated in several database-driven web implementations on museum website.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: WISEngine is a global startup company that owns specialized data integration and transformation technologies upon virtual database platform named IDB(Internet Database) Engine. Worked on several mobile projects for corporate clients (MSN, Yahoo, Lycos, etc) w/ IDB and ASP/PHP. Led and coordinated a team to be responsible for web and mobile projects. Designed/developed a powerful management console snapin to effectively enable to administer single or multiple virtual database server(s) including performance monitoring and reporting capabilities.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed various financial applications w/ VB6, Crystal Reports and SQL7 for clients. Responsible for development and maintenance on company's website in all aspects. Upgraded it to be database-driven and CSS-based.

positions.title: Database Operator/Administrator
positions.description: Performed day-to-day administrative duties on air force military database system built on oracle/unix. Migrated legacy mainframe (PRIME) applications written in COBOL language to unix(solaris) platforms with Oracle database. Developed several client desktop applications running off Microsoft Access database.
